A4 corrected post-run from saved states (cf. #4345 precedent): the targeted permanent WAS shuffled into its owner's library ({'oid': '8', 'name': 'Island', 'controller': 0, 'owner': 0}), but the exile/land-drop step used the spell controller's library ({'oid': '88', 'name': 'Mountain', 'controller': 1, 'owner': 1}) instead of the targeted permanent's owner's library. P0 library 50->51 (only +1 from the shuffled target; nothing exiled from it); P1 library 52->51 (-1: the exiled Mountain entered P1's battlefield). Per Oracle ('exiles the top card of their library', their = the owner) the exiled card should have come from P0's library.

Verdict reasoning: the REPORTED bug is the AI getting stuck 'trying to select a target for this spell endlessly'. The AI cast Audacious Swap 10 times; every cast's target selection completed and the spell resolved within 0.6s (worst observed). No target-selection stall occurred, so the reported loop is not-reproduced on v0.78.0. The wrong-library defect above is a separate finding, documented here and in the issue comment.

P0 ActionRejected entries in the wire log (2) are driver-side races (action submitted from a superseded revision, disposition 'unavailable'), not engine defects; the game advanced normally throughout.

secondary_finding.title: Audacious Swap exiles the top card of the caster's library instead of the targeted permanent's owner's library
secondary_finding.oracle: The owner of target nonenchantment permanent shuffles it into their library, then exiles the top card of their library. If it's a land card, they put it onto the battlefield. Otherwise, they may cast it without paying its mana cost.
secondary_finding.observed: Target P0 Island -> P0 library (correct); then the top card of P1's (caster's) library was exiled and the Mountain put onto P1's battlefield (wrong player).
secondary_finding.parse: Pinned card-data parse is correct: ExileTop player = {"type": "ParentTarget"} (Shuffle step uses ParentTargetOwner and behaved); the engine resolved the player reference to the spell's controller.
secondary_finding.relation_to_report: Distinct defect from the reported AI target-selection loop. Fails triage acceptance criterion 3 ('resolves its later owner decisions through the correct player').
